name_reason: Name already conforms to data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>: prefix data_fd2_ (game global data), domain 'chapter', descriptor 'ch05_end_scene_char_pos_y_table'. 'ch05' is a meaningful chapter ID (chapters 01-30) that must be retained, not Ghidra address residue. Descriptor reflects both the data type (table/array) and the use (per-character Y tile coordinate for the chapter-5 end scene). No hex address suffix in the name.
purpose: Chapter-5 end-scene per-character battle-tile Y coordinate table for the 7 characters staged in the chapter-5 recruit cutscene (recruit char #10).
logic_summary: Read-only const byte table, second of three parallel 7-byte tables (X @ 0x520CF, Y @ 0x520D6, facing @ 0x520DD). The sole reader fd2_chapter_05_end @ 0x231F9 block-copies the 7 raw bytes (MOV ESI,0x520D6 ; LEA EDI,[ESP+0x8] ; MOVSD;MOVSW;MOVSB) onto an on-stack scene block, consumes each entry one byte at a time (no struct stride, no wider element access, no sign extension), and passes the block as the Y-position argument to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro @ 0x233C6.
element_semantics: Each byte is a battle-tile Y coordinate for one of the 7 placed characters in the chapter-5 end cutscene. Values: { 11, 11, 11, 9, 10, 9, 10 } (small tile coords, matched byte-for-byte to live memory 0b 0b 0b 09 0a 09 0a).
